bullets.text: Residents in Poondi staged a protest and besieged the block development office, and the office should monitor local administrative grievances.
Malaimurasu reported action against a scam ring stealing government lands near the Tiruttani sub-registrar, and the office must watch land administration integrity.
Ambattur police inspected and destroyed ganja plants in the Pudur area, and the office should track law enforcement and local safety updates.
L&T secured a large order for AI computing expansion at the Chennai data centre, and the minister's office should monitor infrastructure growth.
